forceDebug: Forced on every throw · Press U to hide
title: Hammer Throw Rally
controlsHelp: Move the mouse up or down to aim. Hold left-click to charge, then release to throw.
overloadHelp: 100% gives a fast, safe throw. Charging beyond it adds power with a small chance of falling.
carryHelp: At 150% and above, releasing the hammer is likely to send you flying with it.
courseHelp: Collect coins, avoid pits and birds, and land the hammer in the hole.
recovering: Get up · Dust off · Grab the chain
chargeCancelled: Charge canceled. Hold left-click to try again.
plane: Plane down! Chute open! Here comes the rescue!
kickWait: Wait for the chain to tighten
timingHelp: Release on the chime for a faster throw and a steadier grip below 150%.
routeHelp: Aim low for a few coins before the pit, or go high for a longer coin arc and rockets among the birds.
kickHelp: When the hammer pulls you into the air, press Space as the chain tightens to kick upward once.
trampolineHelp: Land on a trampoline to bounce back into the air.
